h1.en: A Dynamic (Absolute) Viscosity Units Converting Table is the heading; Diesel 60 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「动力粘度 单位 换算表」，主体仍是柴油60的订单包含川崎双泵 100，并且没有骨料格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 60 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump. Not on Diesel 60. 3500 kg is weight. LZ-60 prints 35 MPa. LZ-60 prints 100 / 125 mm. Do not round it to LZ-60’s 145 kW. Inquire on /en/contact/ with the Diesel 60 path. The output would change with it, from 35 m³/h to 50 m³/h. The order can repeat “Kawasaki double pump 100” because that cell exists. LZ-60 shares the model string and prints a different hydraulic description by omitting this exact “double pump 100” line, with 145 kW and 50 m³/h. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 as 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 350 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The section title “Dynamic (Absolute) Viscosity Units Online Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油60的订单包含川崎双泵 100，并且没有骨料格的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。是 35 m³/h。3500 kg 是重量。LZ-60 印 35 MPa。LZ-60 印 100 / 125 mm。不要把它四舍五入成 LZ-60 的 145 kW。订单可以重复“川崎双泵 100”，因为这一格存在。请带柴油60路径在 /zh/contact/ 询盘。输送量会跟着从 35 m³/h 变成 50 m³/h。LZ-60 共享型号字符串，功率是 145 kW、输送量 50 m³/h，并没有把这句“双泵 100”印成自己的格子。河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 印成 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 350 m、川崎双泵 100、4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。节标题「动力粘度 单位 在线计算」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

question.en: Does “Dynamic (Absolute) Viscosity Units Online Calculator” replace Not on Diesel 60?
question.zh: 「动力粘度 单位 在线计算」会替换「是 35 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Not on Diesel 60 remains the printed wording for Diesel 60 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 35 m³/h。仍是柴油60的订单包含川崎双泵 100，并且没有骨料格已印的说法。

question.en: Where does 3500 kg is weight belong on the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump row?

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。
